step: published adaptive-transfer gate, applied to the existing always-calibrate production matrix
rule: use the elastic-net prediction when train_mse <= tau, otherwise keep the uncalibrated digital-twin response
source: SYN-DIGITS adaptive transfer; tau = 0.15 as published
refitting: none — the gate selects between two columns that already exist

outputs.silicon_targets_calibrated.csv: GATED — the only file that differs from calib/data/
outputs.silicon_fit_diagnostics.csv: original columns plus tau / transferred / source / applied_mean

effect_on_condition_means.unweighted: unchanged by construction — a calibrated column has the same unweighted mean as the raw column it came from, so substituting one for the other cannot move it
effect_on_condition_means.note: moderator cells and Tier-3 effects depend on which respondent holds which value and move more than the condition mean

verification.method: byte-level string comparison against the source column
